facts.value: Provides a compact item-effect entry point using bone selector 0, zero local offset, zero random spread, and spawn-mode request 1. It delegates the supplied effect ID to the general dispatcher; effect-specific rules can force asynchronous spawning or return without spawning, so synchronous submission is not guaranteed.

facts.value: Receives an item game object and effect ID, initializes two stack Vec3 values to zero, and forwards them unchanged to it_80278800 with bone selector 0, mode 1, and trailing scalar 0.0. The dispatcher interprets the vectors and chooses a spawn form according to the effect ID. Mode 1 selects synchronous spawning only in families that test it; forced asynchronous families still pass the item's xBC0 state to efAsync_Spawn, and unsupported IDs may produce no spawn.

facts.value: A void item-effect dispatcher with signature void(Item_GObj* item_gobj, s32 effect_id, s32 bone_index, Vec3* base_offset, Vec3* random_spread, s32 spawn_mode, f32 extra). The effect ID selects the argument schema, and the bone selector is passed to the item joint resolver. Fallback placement copies the base vector and applies per-axis random spread; IDs 0x446 and 0x448 instead pass the original vector directly. In families supporting both spawn forms, exactly spawn_mode == 1 selects efSync_Spawn and other values select efAsync_Spawn. Other effect families force one API regardless of the mode. The final scalar is supplied by the animation decoder but unused throughout the recovered dispatcher.
